fields.description: The most enrolment form submits that one internet address can make in an hour. Blank or 0 uses 20.
fields.label: Submits per IP per Hour

fields.description: The most submits that one phone number can make in a day, however the number is typed. Blank or 0 uses 3.
fields.label: Submits per Phone per Day

fields.description: The most enrolled checks from one internet address an hour. Dropdown lookups count apart. Blank or 0 uses 40.
fields.label: Checks per IP per Hour

fields.description: The most files one visitor can upload in 30 minutes, counting a replaced file again. Blank or 0 uses 10.
fields.label: Uploads per Visitor

fields.description: The most files that one internet address can upload in an hour, across all visitors on it. Blank or 0 uses 40.
fields.label: Uploads per IP per Hour

fields.description: The most unused guest files that the hourly clean-up deletes in one run, oldest first. Blank or 0 uses 500.
fields.label: Clean-up Batch Size
